paragraphs: Alphabet Inc. is an American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It was created through a restructuring of Google on October 2, 2015, and became the parent holding company of Google and several former Google subsidiaries. Alphabet is listed on the large-cap section of the Nasdaq under the ticker symbols GOOGL and GOOG; both classes of stock are components of major stock market indices such as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100. Alphabet has been described as a Big Tech company. As of July 2026, it is the third largest publicly traded company in the world by market capitalization.

The establishment of Alphabet Inc. was prompted by a desire to make the core Google business "cleaner and more accountable" while allowing greater autonomy to group companies that operate in businesses other than Internet services. Founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin announced their resignation from their executive posts in December 2019, with the CEO role to be filled by Sundar Pichai, who is also the CEO of Google. Page and Brin remain employees, board members, and controlling shareholders of Alphabet Inc.

Alphabet Inc. has faced numerous legal and ethical controversies, including a 2017 lawsuit against Uber over stolen self-driving technology, a 2020 privacy settlement over Google+ data exposure, and multiple antitrust actions from the United States, France, and Japan. It has also been accused of labor law violations related to worker organizing and was forced to file for bankruptcy in Russia after its bank account was seized in 2022. In 2023, the company was widely criticized for mass layoffs that impacted 12,000 employees, many of whom discovered their termination only upon losing account access.

people.name: Sundar Pichai
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, Alphabet and Google
people.bio: Sundar became Google's CEO in October 2015 and Alphabet's CEO in December 2019. He previously served as Google's Senior Vice President of Products and Senior Vice President of Android, Chrome and Apps.
people.quote: Sundar Pichai, 53, joined Google in 2004 and was named the Chief Executive Officer of Google in October 2015 and of Alphabet in December 2019.

people.name: Anat Ashkenazi
people.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, Alphabet and Google
people.bio: Anat has served as Alphabet and Google's Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since July 2024. Previously, she was Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Eli Lilly and Company, where she held various finance, strategy, and operations roles after joining in 2001.
people.quote: Anat Ashkenazi, 53, has served as Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer of Alphabet and Google since July 2024.

people.name: Ruth M. Porat
people.title: President and Chief Investment Officer, Alphabet and Google
people.bio: Ruth has served as President and Chief Investment Officer of Alphabet and Google since September 2023, and previously served as their Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer from May 2015 to July 2024. Before joining Google, she was Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Morgan Stanley.
people.quote: Ruth M. Porat, 68, has served as President and Chief Investment Officer of Alphabet and Google since September 2023.

people.name: Philipp Schindler
people.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Business Officer, Google
people.bio: Philipp has served as Google's Senior Vice President and Chief Business Officer since August 2015. His previous Google roles included Vice President of Global Sales and Operations, President for Northern and Central Europe, and Managing Director for Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Nordics.
people.quote: Philipp Schindler, 55, has served as Senior Vice President, Chief Business Officer of Google since August 2015

people.name: Kent Walker
people.title: President, Global Affairs, Chief Legal Officer and Secretary, Alphabet and Google
people.bio: Kent has served as President, Global Affairs, and Chief Legal Officer of Alphabet and Google since November 2021, and Secretary of Alphabet since January 2020. He previously held executive positions at Netscape, AOL, and eBay and served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney.
people.quote: Kent Walker, 65, has served as President, Global Affairs, and Chief Legal Officer of Alphabet and Google since November 2021

people.name: Larry Page
people.title: Co-Founder; Director
people.bio: One of Google's Co-Founders, Larry previously served as Google's Chief Executive Officer and as Alphabet's Chief Executive Officer from October 2015 to December 2019.
people.quote: Larry Page, 53, one of Google's Co-Founders, previously served as Google's Chief Executive Officer from April 2011 to October 2015

people.name: Sergey Brin
people.title: Co-Founder; Director
people.bio: One of Google's Co-Founders, Sergey previously served as Google's President and as Alphabet's President from October 2015 to December 2019.
people.quote: Sergey Brin, 52, one of Google's Co-Founders, previously served as Google's President from May 2011 to October 2015

people.name: Sundar Pichai
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, Alphabet and Google; Director
people.bio: Sundar joined Google in 2004 and became Google's Chief Executive Officer in October 2015 and Alphabet's Chief Executive Officer in December 2019. He previously led product and engineering for Google's products and platforms.
people.quote: Sundar Pichai, 53, joined Google in 2004 and was named the Chief Executive Officer of Google in October 2015

people.name: John L. Hennessy
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: John has served as Chair of the Board since January 2018, having previously served as Lead Independent Director from April 2007. He served as President of Stanford University from September 2000 to August 2016.
people.quote: John L. Hennessy, 73, has served as Chair of our Board since January 2018.

people.name: Frances H. Arnold
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Frances manages a research group and serves as the Linus Pauling Professor of Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering and Biochemistry and Director of the Donna and Benjamin M. Rosen Bioengineering Center at the California Institute of Technology. Her honors include the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
people.quote: Frances H. Arnold, 69, manages a research group, is the Linus Pauling Professor of Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering and Biochemistry

people.name: R. Martin "Marty" Ch vez
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Marty has been a Partner and Vice Chairman of Sixth Street since May 2021. He previously held executive positions at Goldman Sachs, including Chief Information Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and global co-head of its Securities Division.
people.quote: R. Martin "Marty" Ch vez, 62, has been a Partner and Vice Chairman of Sixth Street, a global asset manager, since May 2021.

people.name: L. John Doerr
people.title: Independent Director
committees: Leadership Development, Inclusion and Compensation Committee
people.bio: John has been Chair of Kleiner Perkins since March 2016, after serving as General Partner since August 1980. He is the author of Measure What Matters and Speed & Scale.
people.quote: L. John Doerr, 74, has been the Chair of Kleiner Perkins, a venture capital firm, since March 2016.

people.name: Roger W. Ferguson Jr.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Roger has been Chief Investment Officer of Red Cell Partners LLC since August 2022. He previously served as President and Chief Executive Officer of TIAA and as Vice Chairman of the U.S. Federal Reserve System.
people.quote: Roger W. Ferguson Jr., 74, has been the Chief Investment Officer of Red Cell Partners LLC, a venture capital firm, since August 2022.

people.name: K. Ram Shriram
people.title: Independent Director
committees: Leadership Development, Inclusion and Compensation Committee
people.bio: Ram has been a managing partner of Sherpalo Ventures, LLC since January 2000. He previously served as Vice President of Business Development at Amazon.com and President of Junglee Corporation.
people.quote: K. Ram Shriram, 69, has been a managing partner of Sherpalo Ventures, LLC, an angel venture investment company, since January 2000.

people.name: Robin L. Washington
people.title: Independent Director
committees: Leadership Development, Inclusion and Compensation Committee (Chair)
people.bio: Robin has been President and Chief Operating and Financial Officer of Salesforce, Inc. since March 2025.
people.quote: Robin L. Washington, 63, has been the President and Chief Operating and Financial Officer of Salesforce, Inc.
